groups.why: Both rows check the same whole-screen GROUP and row-value lock rules in edit_expect.csv with the same expected result, and eg_auth.spec.ts records EG377 and EG378 from the same per-account, per-Div comparison, so one measurement serves both.
This row checks each Measure cell against the GET_ADMIN_GROUP_MEASURE lookup, which is a different source and target from the edit_expect GROUP rules.
It also checks the GET_ADMIN_GROUP_MEASURE time window and expects DM PLANNER to be blocked from editing MKT_FCST[R+P], which EG376 does not expect, so it stays alone.
It covers only columns with a GROUP condition, while EG377 and EG378 also cover row-value lock rules, so a shared result could fail this row for the wrong reason.
It checks a different state, the Cutoff and SCP Final status, and expects edit and save to be blocked with a cannot-modify popup.
It checks a different element, whether the AS From Site combo is enabled, and the Measure candidates for each Sales Site type.
It covers several Measures in the Current version and expects different conditions for each, such as AS_In_Req, VMI_In_Req and the AS From Site list, so it does not fully match any other row.
